title: Resident car parking: no minimum in Location A or B (Table 3.9)
text: Parking is provided for cars and motorcycles in accordance with Table 3.9. Table 3.9 Resident car parking: No minimum (Location A and Location B).

replaces.note: Location A 0.75 (1-bed) / 1 (2+ bed) and Location B 1 / 1.25 bays per dwelling -> no minimum

notes: Register C4P2-098 (Location A) and C4P2-099 (Location B): resident minimum removed. table-3.9-resident returns 0 for both locations, so the rule only reports the provision. Location A: within 800 m of a high-frequency rail station (pedestrian entry to platform, straight line, to any part of the lot), within 250 m of a high-frequency transit route (or routes combining to 15-minute weekday peak stops, 7-9am and 5-7pm), and/or within an activity centre boundary; Location B: all other land (C4P2-105, unchanged). ToC says Location A applies to Perth and Peel only; no such limit is in the Part 2 text (C4P2-098). Footnote 2 (one car bay less per five motorcycle bays) has no resident minimum to reduce.
